property_summary: Reference contract preserves that a successful Collect call never allows the caller (or any reentrant attacker) to withdraw more than their recorded balance (i.e., after Collect returns, Acc(k).balance == oldBalance - withdrawnAmount for the account k); removing the require(!locked_) allows reentrant withdrawal so some input (reentrant attacker, withdraw amount) can make Acc balance decrease more than expected causing the property to fail.
change_summary: Replace the nonReentrant_ modifier body to remove the require check, allowing reentrancy by not preventing reentrant entries.
